_doc: Sling Bounce sprites (steps 3, 3.1, 4). PLACE BY ANCHOR, NEVER BY CANVAS: put anchor_px3 (/1.5 for @2x) on the engine coordinate; canvases include padding, the 4px ink outline and the rim margin, so a canvas corner is never an engine position. collision_px3 = the engine collider in this file's pixels; body_px3 = measured opaque box [x0,y0,x1,y1]. Coordinates in px of the file's own scale family: *_px3 values are @3x; divide by 1.5 for @2x. Pivot = visual centre unless listed. Night-rim layers: same name under <category>/night-rim/, canvas +12px@3x (+8px@2x), drawn first at offset (-6,-6)@3x / (-4,-4)@2x; used in Orbit + Deep Space.
